fruit.grandline.hai.desc: ORIGINAL — Ash-Ash Fruit (Logia): become the volcanic ash of the New World's burning islands. Smouldering cinders, choking clouds, a pyroclastic surge and ash that sets like stone around a body. Fire passes through you; water turns you to slurry (+30%, always connects).
A smouldering clot of ash and embers that bursts in a blinding puff.
ability.grandline.fruit.hai.ash_cloud.de: A dense ash cloud hangs over a point for six seconds: enemies inside choke, go blind and lose track.
ability.grandline.fruit.hai.pyroclastic_: Collapse into a burning avalanche of ash and rush forward, burying and scorching everyone in the way.
ability.grandline.fruit.hai.ash_cast.des: Ash settles on the target and sets like stone around it, holding it fast.
ability.grandline.fruit.hai.ashfall.desc: Ash rains over a wide area, heavier every second, until the hot ash flares up.
ability.grandline.fruit.hai.volcanic_win: The ash blots out the sun: enemies choke in darkness and grow heavier until they are cast in ash; allies vanish in the gloom.
fruit.grandline.yako.desc: ORIGINAL — Glow-Glow Fruit (Logia): become a cloud of glowing plankton, the living light of the deep sea. Marking sparks, an angler's lure, startle-flashes and a sea that glows milky white. Stronger in the dark; marked enemies take 20% more from you. Darkness smothers you (+30%, always connects).
ability.grandline.fruit.yako.glow_bead.d: A spark of living light that clings to whoever it hits and marks them.
An angler's lure bobs at a point: enemies are drawn in and dazed, then it bursts.
ability.grandline.fruit.yako.abyssal_fla: The startle-flash of a deep-sea creature: a cone of blinding light; enemies reel and lose you.
ability.grandline.fruit.yako.sea_sparkle: The swarm spreads wide: every enemy around is marked and revealed; allies see in the dark and move quicker.
ability.grandline.fruit.yako.living_ligh: Scatter into the swarm and gather again behind the target in a burst of light.
ability.grandline.fruit.yako.milky_sea.d: The ground or sea around you glows milky white for ten seconds: enemies are dazzled and burned, allies mend unseen.
fruit.grandline.shinku.desc: ORIGINAL — Vacuum-Vacuum Fruit (Logia): the thin air of the White Sea taken to its end — become empty space. Imploding spheres, stolen breath, a dome of dead air and a blast of decompression. Immune to wind and sound, fire burns at half strength, stronger in thin air. Impact shockwaves always connect (+25%).
ability.grandline.fruit.shinku.void_bull: A sphere of nothing that implodes where it lands, dragging nearby enemies in.
ability.grandline.fruit.shinku.breathles: Pull the air from the target's lungs: choking damage over three seconds while it gasps.
ability.grandline.fruit.shinku.implosion: Everything around a point — projectiles too — is sucked into a hole of nothing and crushed when it snaps shut.
A dome of vacuum for eight seconds: no flame burns and no arrow flies inside; enemies gasp; ranged blows lose their force on you.
ability.grandline.fruit.shinku.decompres: Release the void: everything around is blasted away and you ride the rebound high into the air.
ability.grandline.fruit.shinku.absolute_: A vast hole of nothing drags everything to its centre while choking, then the sky rushes back in with a thunderclap.
fruit.grandline.kai.desc: ORIGINAL — Shell-Shell Fruit (Special Paramecia): your body grows the Dials of the White Sea and works like every one of them — Breath, Flame, Flash, Jet, Milky and Impact, and at awakening the forbidden Reject Dial. A tenth of every melee blow you take is stored as impact; in the White Sea the shells recharge quickly.
A gust of stored wind bursts from the palm and blows enemies away.
ability.grandline.fruit.kai.flame_dial.d: The stored heat of the sun fired as a burst of flame.
ability.grandline.fruit.kai.flash_dial.d: A palm full of stored light: a blinding flash in front.
The palm drinks in every blow for two and a half seconds (75% soaked), then the stored impact bursts out in front.
ability.grandline.fruit.kai.jet_dial.des: Shoot forward like a Waver at full jet, ramming through anyone in the way.
ability.grandline.fruit.kai.milky_dial.d: A road of cloud unrolls from your feet — across the sea, over a gap, up to a ledge (temporary).
Ten times the stored impact, point-blank past any guard. The recoil wracks your own body.
fruit.grandline.fusen.desc: ORIGINAL — Balloon-Balloon Fruit: blow anything up like a balloon. Balloon bombs, enemies puffed up until they float helplessly away (and pop), a bouncy body and, at awakening, a whole battlefield lifted towards the White Sea. Blunt blows -25%, no fall damage; sharp things pop you (+25%).
ability.grandline.fruit.fusen.balloon_bo: A tight-packed balloon that bursts on impact and bounces everyone near upward.
ability.grandline.fruit.fusen.inflate.de: The target swells and floats helplessly up for three seconds — then it pops.
ability.grandline.fruit.fusen.bounce_bod: Puff yourself up: blunt blows bounce off (-50%), attackers are bounced back, your jumps are huge.
ability.grandline.fruit.fusen.float_away: Puff up and rise out of reach, dropping a balloon bomb where you stood, then drift down slowly.
ability.grandline.fruit.fusen.balloon_bo: A balloon is tied to every enemy around: they float up together, then all pop.
ability.grandline.fruit.fusen.great_asce: Everything in a wide area swells and rises high into the sky, then pops all at once far above the ground.
fruit.grandline.shinju.desc: ORIGINAL — Pearl-Pearl Fruit: like an oyster of Fish-Man Island's coral beds, you secrete nacre. Pearls fired like shot, layers of pearl armour that each break one blow, irritants coated shut in pearl, a blinding lustre and, at awakening, a black pearl. One layer regrows every ten seconds.
ability.grandline.fruit.shinju.pearl_sho: A hard, gleaming pearl fired like a musket ball.
ability.grandline.fruit.shinju.nacre_arm: Three layers of pearl grow over you (up to six); each one halves a single blow.
ability.grandline.fruit.shinju.pearl_pri: Like grit in an oyster, the target is coated layer on layer until it is shut in pearl.
ability.grandline.fruit.shinju.lustre.de: Every layer of nacre bursts into iridescent light at once: enemies around are dazzled and struck, harder for every layer spent.
ability.grandline.fruit.shinju.black_pea: The strongest foe nearby is swallowed by a giant black pearl and crushed in it; you wear its nacre afterwards.
fruit.grandline.kagi.desc: ORIGINAL — Key-Key Fruit: everything has a lock and you hold every key. Lock joints stiff, lock away an enemy's techniques, unlock your own limits. Born on the dark side of Sabaody; the one lock it can never pick is seastone. Your own joints cannot be locked; locked enemies take 20% more from you.
ability.grandline.fruit.kagi.key_shot.de: A brass key flies into the target and turns: its joints click stiff for a moment.
A key turns in the target's knees: rooted for three seconds.
ability.grandline.fruit.kagi.lock_away.d: Lock the target's techniques away for five seconds — fruit powers, style moves, racial gifts and weapon arts.
ability.grandline.fruit.kagi.unlock.desc: You and nearby allies are unlocked: slows, roots and stagger fall away, and your limits open (strength, speed).
ability.grandline.fruit.kagi.lockdown.de: Keys turn in every enemy around at once: joints rooted, techniques locked.
The key to everything: your own powers spring back (cooldowns reset) and every enemy in a wide area is locked down.
fruit.grandline.hanabi.desc: ORIGINAL — Firework-Firework Fruit: your body is packed like a festival night in Wano. Rockets, sparklers, a rocket to ride, star mines, the great chrysanthemum shell and a grand finale. Fire cannot burn you; damp powder — water +30% and your fire is weaker when wet.
ability.grandline.fruit.hanabi.rocket.de: A bottle rocket whistles off the fingertip and bursts on impact.
Both hands become fizzing sparklers: three quick slashes of sparks.
ability.grandline.fruit.hanabi.rocket_ri: Ride a rocket forward and up, then come down in a shower of sparks.
ability.grandline.fruit.hanabi.star_mine: Five shells are planted around a point and burst one after another.
ability.grandline.fruit.hanabi.chrysanth: The classic great shell opens over the target into a falling chrysanthemum of fire.
ability.grandline.fruit.hanabi.grand_fin: For four seconds the sky erupts — shell after shell over every enemy around, ending in one enormous chrysanthemum.
fruit.grandline.hata.desc: ORIGINAL — Flag-Flag Fruit: raise flags out of thin air, and whatever flag flies over a place is its law. A flagpole spear, a Jolly Roger brand, a banner that claims territory, a snapping flag, forced white flags and an Emperor's territory. You take 20% less under your own flag; branded enemies take 20% more from everyone.
ability.grandline.fruit.hata.flagpole_th: A flagpole springs out of your hand like a spear and runs through the line in front.
ability.grandline.fruit.hata.jolly_roger: Brand your flag onto the target: it glows and takes 20% more damage from everyone for twelve seconds.
ability.grandline.fruit.hata.plant_the_f: Plant a banner: for fifteen seconds its territory strengthens and shields allies and weighs on enemies.
ability.grandline.fruit.hata.flag_wave.d: A huge flag snaps open: the gust blows enemies away and knocks projectiles out of the air.
White flags are forced up over every enemy around: they drop their target, their blows grow weak and their feet heavy.
ability.grandline.fruit.hata.emperors_te: Your flag flies over a whole area for twenty seconds: allies grow far stronger and mend; every enemy is branded and ground down.
fruit.grandline.taru.desc: ORIGINAL — Barrel-Barrel Fruit: barrels of every kind come out of your body, and you can roll up inside one. Thrown barrels, a barrel roll, powder kegs, a barrel bunker, grog for the crew and an avalanche of barrels. Iron hoops (blunt -15%); the staves are wood (fire +20%).
ability.grandline.fruit.taru.barrel_toss: A heavy water butt hurled at the target.
ability.grandline.fruit.taru.barrel_roll: Curl up inside a barrel and roll forward, bowling over everyone in the way.
A keg of black powder with a lit fuse; it explodes where it lands (the ground is unharmed).
ability.grandline.fruit.taru.barrel_bunk: Shut yourself into an iron-hooped barrel: 70% of all damage is soaked and attackers are shoved off.
ability.grandline.fruit.taru.grog_ration: A cask of grog for the crew: heals, feeds and puts fight in their bellies.
ability.grandline.fruit.taru.barrel_aval: Dozens of barrels tumble out of the sky onto an area; every fourth one is a powder keg.
fruit.grandline.kujira_bakekujira: Kujira Kujira no Mi, Model: Bakekujira
mastery.grandline.fruit.kujira_bakekujir: Kujira Kujira no Mi, Model: Bakekujira Mastery
fruit.grandline.kujira_bakekujira.desc: ORIGINAL — Whale-Whale Fruit, Model: Ghost Whale (Mythical Zoan): the skeletal ghost whale of the New World's sailors' tales, swimming through the air instead of the sea. Breaches, a chilling song, a swallow, rib harpoons and a whale falling out of the sky. In form, plain blows lose 20% and you never fall hard; light banishes you (+25%).
ability.grandline.fruit.kujira_bakekujir: Cycle human → hybrid → full ghost whale (awakened form after awakening).
The whale rises out of the ground around you and slams down, throwing enemies up.
A long, mournful whale song: every enemy around withers, slows and is lost in fear.
Swim through the air for eight seconds: rise gently, glide fast and never fall hard.
Swallow one target whole, grind it in the dark of your ribcage, then spit it out.
Hurl three ribs like harpoons: they pierce through and drag targets down.
A colossal ghost whale dives out of the sky onto an area: everything beneath is crushed and cursed, ships stove in.
fruit.grandline.itachi_raiju: Itachi Itachi no Mi, Model: Raiju
mastery.grandline.fruit.itachi_raiju: Itachi Itachi no Mi, Model: Raiju Mastery
fruit.grandline.itachi_raiju.desc: ORIGINAL — Weasel-Weasel Fruit, Model: Raiju (Mythical Zoan): the thunder beast of the White Sea's storm clouds, which falls to earth inside a lightning bolt. Arcing claws, a pounce along a bolt, ball lightning, a fall from the clouds, a static coat and a rampage of lightning. In form immune to lightning; attackers are shocked; faster and stronger in storms.
ability.grandline.fruit.itachi_raiju.tra: Cycle human → hybrid → full thunder beast (awakened form after awakening).
ability.grandline.fruit.itachi_raiju.thu: A raking claw full of lightning; the charge arcs on to the next enemy.
ability.grandline.fruit.itachi_raiju.sto: Spring along a flash of lightning straight onto your prey.
ability.grandline.fruit.itachi_raiju.bal: A crackling ball of lightning that bursts on impact, zapping everyone near.
ability.grandline.fruit.itachi_raiju.thu: Leap into the clouds and come down a moment later as a lightning bolt on the target.
ability.grandline.fruit.itachi_raiju.sta: Your coat bristles with charge: you run fast and anyone striking you is shocked.
ability.grandline.fruit.itachi_raiju.rai: Become lightning and leap from enemy to enemy across a wide area, ending in a thunderclap.
fruit.grandline.sasori_seascorpion: Sasori Sasori no Mi, Model: Jaekelopterus
mastery.grandline.fruit.sasori_seascorpi: Sasori Sasori no Mi, Model: Jaekelopterus Mastery
fruit.grandline.sasori_seascorpion.desc: ORIGINAL — Scorpion-Scorpion Fruit, Model: Sea Scorpion (Ancient Zoan): the giant sea scorpion of the ancient oceans, a legend of the deep around Fish-Man Island. Armour-cracking pincers, a venomous tail spike, a sideways scuttle, a hardened carapace, venom spines and phantom pincers. In form, cuts and thrusts -20%; heavy blows crack the shell (+20%).
ability.grandline.fruit.sasori_seascorpi: Cycle human → hybrid → full sea scorpion (awakened form after awakening).
The great pincers close on the target and squeeze three times, cracking any guard.
The tail spike whips over your shoulder along a line: venom and a moment of paralysis.
A sudden sideways scuttle (alternating left and right) out of harm's way.
Harden the exoskeleton for eight seconds: resistance, and melee attackers chip on the shell.
Flick a fan of five venom spines.
Phantom pincers burst out of the ground along a line, seizing, crushing and envenoming every enemy in their path.
fruit.grandline.tonbo_meganeura: Tonbo Tonbo no Mi, Model: Meganeura
mastery.grandline.fruit.tonbo_meganeura: Tonbo Tonbo no Mi, Model: Meganeura Mastery
fruit.grandline.tonbo_meganeura.desc: ORIGINAL — Dragonfly-Dragonfly Fruit, Model: Griffinfly (Ancient Zoan): the giant dragonfly of the ancient skies, at home over the White Sea. Cutting wings, darts in any direction, hovering, a snatch that carries prey up and drops it, compound eyes and a phantom swarm. In form no fall damage and a quick flier; one blow in ten sidestepped. Thin wings burn (+25%).
Cycle human → hybrid → full griffinfly (awakened form after awakening).
The four great wings beat into a cutting buzz in front.
An instant dart in any direction you look (up and down too), slicing through what is in the way.
Your wings hold you aloft for six seconds: a short rise, then a slow drift.
Seize your prey, carry it up into the sky, then let go.
See in every direction at once: hidden enemies are revealed and one blow in four is sidestepped.
A swarm of phantom griffinflies dives again and again on every enemy around.
fruit.grandline.kaba_hippo: Kaba Kaba no Mi, Model: Hippopotamus
mastery.grandline.fruit.kaba_hippo: Kaba Kaba no Mi, Model: Hippopotamus Mastery
fruit.grandline.kaba_hippo.desc: ORIGINAL — Hippo-Hippo Fruit (Zoan): the river horse of the Sabaody mangrove swamps — and hippos never could swim. Gaping jaws, a thundering charge, healing blood sweat, a mud wallow, a territorial bellow and the stampede of the Behemoth. In form a thick hide (blunt and slash -20%); you mend in mud.
ability.grandline.fruit.kaba_hippo.trans: Cycle human → hybrid → full hippo (awakened form after awakening).
ability.grandline.fruit.kaba_hippo.gapin: The jaws gape wide and slam shut on everything in front.
ability.grandline.fruit.kaba_hippo.river: A thundering charge: everyone in the path is run down and thrown.
ability.grandline.fruit.kaba_hippo.blood: The hippo's red sweat: heals, regenerates, toughens the hide, puts out fire and washes poison away.
ability.grandline.fruit.kaba_hippo.mud_w: The ground around you turns to deep mud (temporary): enemies are bogged down while you mend.
ability.grandline.fruit.kaba_hippo.terri: Yawn your huge jaws wide and bellow: enemies around are shoved back, shaken and lose their nerve.
ability.grandline.fruit.kaba_hippo.behem: Become the Behemoth of legend and stamp three times, each stamp a quake that throws everything into the air.
